verdict_vocabulary.genuine_exclusivist_confession: the sentence, in a voice the text endorses, asserts that only this divinity exists; the grammar of the sentence is a confession of sole divinity
verdict_vocabulary.monolatrous_prohibition_presupposing_oth: the sentence regulates whom may be worshipped, acknowledged or associated, and its wording grammatically presupposes that other gods exist to be regulated; denying them worship is not denying existence, so it cannot witness to the oneness doctrine
verdict_vocabulary.non_doctrinal_substring_collision: the pattern hit a substring inside an unrelated construction; the sentence says nothing about how many divinities exist
verdict_vocabulary.editorial_description_of_formula: an editor's or essayist's prose reports that the formula is said, believed or recited; it is evidence about the currency of a confession, not the confession's own text
verdict_vocabulary.divine_formula_in_non_divine_mouth: the divine first-person confession form is placed in the mouth of a human or a personified city; inside the scripture this is a boast being reported, not a confession being made
verdict_vocabulary.conditional_or_hypothetical: the formula occurs only inside the scope of a hypothesis or counterfactual; the text asserts neither the confession nor its denial
verdict_vocabulary.reported_speech_of_denial: the confession form is uttered by a figure the narrative presents as a denier whose profession is refused; the words have the shape of the doctrine, the speaker is not its witness
verdict_vocabulary.unresolved_needs_second_coder: the context does not allow this coder to decide; reserved for the reliability pass and reported rather than quietly resolved

survives_after_correction.definition: matches adjudicated as confessions of sole divinity, in the whitespace-normalised scan, in works that the configured source-dependence rules do not mark as dependent on another corpus work. The field keeps its v1 spelling for the artifact schema; it means `not marked dependent`, not `independence established` -- see disposition_table.headline

independence.statement: 34 matches classified as confessional across two works not marked dependent under the currently configured source-dependence rules. Independence has not been established because dependence closure remains incomplete.
independence.why_the_first_number_is_not_an_independe: `counts_as_independent_attestation: true` records only that no rule in config/source_dependence.json places this work's text under another corpus work. That is the absence of a declared edge, not a proof of separate transmission: the file lists pair rules one by one, there is no closure over the whole corpus, and two works can be independent reprints of one non-corpus source while no rule mentions either. The same file also marks a work dependent where its wording recurs in the declared source, so a translation pair whose renderings diverge is not caught by the verbatim test at all
independence.what_would_establish_it: a declared dependence closure over every work pair and every external source they reprint, plus a per-match attribution the second coder confirms -- neither of which exists in this repository

correction.headline: of the published 4 works and 4 traditions, 2 works and 2 traditions survive: the anthology's matches all sit in a work the rules mark dependent on a corpus source, the Book of Mormon's single hit is a substring collision, and the two surviving witnesses are the King James Bible and the Qur'an in Rodwell's translation. The hit count is not 46: whitespace normalisation raises it to 51, of which 34 are confessional matches in works not marked dependent
correction.direction_of_the_error: the published number both overstated breadth -- one source counted twice, two non-doctrinal collisions counted as doctrine, one worship prohibition counted as an existence claim -- and understated the doctrine's density inside the two surviving witnesses, where line-wrapped confessions are invisible to the literal patterns. Any corrected sentence needs the smaller work set and the larger hit count at the same time

limitations.adjudication: every `analyst_verdict` in this file is one analyst's reading of the published context, made while building this tool. No second coder has reviewed any verdict, there is no agreement statistic and no arbitration step, so the verdict column is the INPUT TO a reliability test and not the RESULT of one. The provenance is recorded on every row as `single_analyst_reading, not independently verified`
limitations.no_human_annotation_was_performed: the repository contains no annotation file for this family and none was created here; `competing_reading` names the alternative a second coder might choose, it is not a second coder's judgement
limitations.suspiciously_clean_single_pass: this coder left no record unresolved, and a pass that turns on source-critical judgements that never has to say `I cannot tell` is itself evidence that the adjudications need independent re-coding before any of them is cited
limitations.context_window: verdicts were read from the `sentence` and `context_snippet` fields published here; a reviewer who reads a wider context can legitimately change a row, and the sentence-level cut is itself an analyst choice (printed verse numbers and chapter headings can break a clause in the middle)
limitations.translation_boundaries: the corpus is monolingual English. Every verdict is about the wording of a particular translation, so a confession absent from this rendering is not absent from the composition; the line-wrap recall failure is the direct proof of how thin this evidence is
limitations.attribution_boundaries: attributions are resolved from the works' own printed matter. Where the printed text cannot support a locator -- neither Qur'an witness prints verse numbers -- the field is published null with the reason rather than filled in from outside knowledge
limitations.genre_boundaries: a text matching the confession grammar is not evidence that anyone believed it: these counts are vocabulary in translation prose, not attested doctrine, and no count here can address the existence or non-existence of supernatural beings
limitations.rule_coverage: the missed-formula probe reports formula classes the family does not carry but does not fold them into it, so the corrected counts here remain counts of the family's own patterns and are a floor, not a ceiling
limitations.second_coder_protocol: to use this file as the input to a reliability test: re-code `matches[].context_snippet` and `matches[].sentence` blind against the same vocabulary, then report agreement per verdict and adjudicate the disagreements
